name: EH3D-PHOENIX-CAD
build: cargo build --release; cargo test; python -I tools/ci_validate.py
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.5: early code. Mechanical design for the PHOENIX family: parametric enclosures, chassis and heat sinks that live in the same project as the board. What exists is the base of every repository of the suite, the written scope, requirements, dependencies, threat model and decisions in docs/, and a Rust library with a parametric enclosure (lengths with their own range, round holes, change operations that report conflicts, an OpenSCAD-style script and a fit check, and a 2D sketch with constraints and a solver that is kept in the project file and whose closed outlines can be raised from a face or cut into it). It has only been tried on models made by its own tests; it has a command line and a window (never opened on a screen), a STEP file checked only for its structure that does not draw the cooling fins or the parts, patterns of holes and posts, sets of cooling fins with a simple estimate of their heat, a catalog of generic parts (profiles, screws and brackets) placed in the model with a bill of materials, a cut list and the mass of each material, simple assemblies of those parts (mates along one axis and a check of which parts share volume), and nothing has been run on a machine.
